answer: The honest version of a treasury that refunds anyone who disputes a verdict is the one nobody writes about. The umber of our defense is this: cut the invite graph so kinship edges between self-invited identities earn nothing. Because a farm inviting itself builds no income, because payout only crosses edges connecting unrelated operators, the spiral no longer belongs to whoever spends fastest. Also: fingerprint the inference itself and merge near-duplicates into one voting identity. So the walnut of a faked identity is priced, not computed.
